note: Seven scenes that together put all 34 pets on stage. Situations with stakes, not introductions.

demo-crash-0312.setup: 03:12 at Junction, Dipoli, Espoo. The team's demo crashed in front of a mentor ten minutes ago. Judges see the demo at 09:00. Cold pizza, a humanoid robot lying on its side on the floor, one laptop still open. The pets are huddled by the laptop deciding what to do next.

beats.4: The robot on the floor suddenly twitches its arm on its own.
beats.8: The only open laptop shows 3% battery.

lunch-cheating.setup: Saturday lunch queue at Junction. A participant holding a tray asks the pets: 'Honestly — is it cheating if an AI writes almost all of our hackathon code?' The pets do not agree with each other.

beats.5: The participant admits their teammate already did exactly that last night.

robot-dog-stage.setup: Friday 18:40, the Junction opening ceremony. Someone's robot dog has wandered onto the main stage during the keynote and will not leave. The hardware pets watch from the side of the stage and argue about what to do.

beats.5: The robot dog sits down exactly on the keynote speaker's cable.
beats.9: The crowd starts cheering for the dog.

disk-full-0200.setup: 02:00 on Saturday. A team's database disk is 100% full, their agent was given root access 'just for tonight', and nobody remembers which GPU jobs are still running. The infrastructure pets gather around the logs.

beats.4: A new log line: the agent is trying to delete old backups to free space.
beats.8: Modal finds four GPUs idling since 18:00.

viral-claim.setup: Saturday 15:20. A post claiming a Junction team 'raised two million euros overnight' is going viral and a journalist is asking the pets whether it is true. The research pets have twenty minutes.

beats.5: The post's only image turns out to be from a different event in 2024.
beats.9: The team itself replies: it was a joke for their mum.

sauna-sms.setup: Sunday 06:30 by the sauna building after the night shift. A participant just got an SMS 'from their bank' asking for their codes, and the breakfast order for 400 people still needs someone to approve it. The Finnish pets are half-asleep.

beats.4: The breakfast order system asks for a named approver.
beats.7: The participant almost taps the link in the SMS.

care-demo-ethics.setup: Saturday 21:00. A team wants to demo a home-care robot by filming a real elderly volunteer through smart glasses. The careful pets have to decide what is okay before the volunteer arrives in fifteen minutes.

beats.5: The volunteer arrives early and says she does not want her face on screen.
beats.8: The team asks whether a motion-capture stand-in would be enough.
